title: Turkey Shepherd's Pie
shortDescription: Lean turkey and vegetable filling under whipped sweet potato mash
subtitle: Lean turkey and vegetable filling under whipped sweet potato mash
description: Ground turkey and mixed vegetables simmer in savory gravy, topped with whipped sweet potato mash and baked until golden.

steps.title: Boil and mash sweet potatoes
steps.instruction: Boil sweet potato cubes 15–18 minutes until fork-tender. Drain well, mash with butter, milk, and 1 tsp salt until smooth and spreadable.

steps.title: Brown turkey and onion
steps.instruction: Cook ground turkey and onion over medium-high 10 minutes, breaking into crumbles until no pink remains and onion turns translucent at edges.

steps.title: Build savory filling
steps.instruction: Add garlic, tomato paste, thyme; cook 2 minutes. Stir in mixed vegetables, broth, Worcestershire. Simmer 10 minutes until thick and gravy-coated.

steps.title: Assemble and top
steps.instruction: Spread filling in greased hotel pan. Pipe or spread sweet potato mash evenly over top with textured peaks for browning.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.instruction: Bake at 400°F 25–30 minutes until mash peaks turn golden and filling bubbles at edges. Center should be hot throughout when pierced.

proTips: A pinch of cinnamon in sweet potato mash complements savory filling.
Add rosemary to turkey filling for depth without extra salt.
Portion with a square cutter for uniform crew servings.
leftovers: Reheat squares covered with foil—add broth if filling dried.
Freeze individual portions for emergency comfort meals.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Classic comfort food without heavy beef grease. Sweet potato top adds color and fiber crews appreciate.
mealPrepNotes: Boil sweet potatoes while turkey filling simmers. Pipe or spread mash evenly for pretty portions. Station: Use a 4-inch deep hotel pan for clean slice portions across eight servings. Station: Let filling cool slightly before topping—hot filling melts mash into the gravy layer. Station: Broil last 3 minutes for golden peaks if oven time allows.
